blocks.html: As part of Robinsons Malls’ support with the LGU’s COVID-19 prevention and vaccination efforts, Robinsons Place Antipolo now provides a safe and convenient venue for the communities to get vaccinated.
Located at the Mall Atrium, the vaccination center has prioritized senior citizens, health workers and frontliners. Over 1,000 constituents have been vaccinated .

For more updates, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or like Robinsons Malls on Facebook; follow @RobinsonsMallsOfficial on Instagram and @RobinsonsMalls on Twitter; and join their Viber Communities – Robinsons Malls Luzon for Luzon malls and Robinsons Malls VisMin for Visayas and Mindanao malls.
